price.paid: $0.99 USDC on Base via x402: one 24-hour Day Pass, then use its key or bind it to _session_id

description: Agent-native access activation endpoint. Accepts an optional payment envelope or existing access key and returns a payment challenge or verified activation result. Activation results include receipt URL, run ID, access key, expiration, usage guidance, and a spend receipt. Activation occurs only after a verified transfer.

_caller_label.description: Optional caller label recorded as a caller-reported claim in the receipt.

_continuity_ai_label.description: Optional self-reported AI client label for the private continuity timeline. Zambo does not independently verify the client.

_ref.description: Optional handover referral ID from your install link.

_session_id.description: Optional stable bot-job ID. Reuse it across calls to bind a Day Pass and keep the job ledger together.

_zambo_key.description: Optional opaque Zambo access capability. Never place it in a URL or public log.

sponsor.description: Explicitly sponsor another team's closed workflow; branding ownership never transfers.

workflow_id.description: Optional workflow to seal after verified payment.

x_payment.description: Base64 JSON x402 payment envelope recorded from the live challenge, sent as X-Payment.
